motivation.operator_requirement: Add ZEC while retaining the crypto roster and keeping only SPCX and SNDK from the non-crypto roster.
motivation.inherited_evidence: V73 development supported opening unchanged validation for BTC, ETH, and HYPE; SOL remained largest-winner dependent and observe-only.
motivation.testable_extension: Apply the unchanged completed-4h SMA/ATR lifecycle to ZEC without using ZEC outcomes to select parameters.

zec_venue_contract.startup_requirement: refresh metadata and fail closed on symbol, precision, or maximum-leverage mismatch
zec_venue_contract.fee_requirement: use exact current account perp fees at preflight and retain 4.5 bps per side as the conservative research assumption

chronology.warmup: source window begins before the scored development interval for completed-4h SMA30 and ATR14 state
chronology.opening_rule: Open ZEC development first; do not retune. Open validation once only if development clears nominal and stress support including largest-winner sensitivity.

data_contract.candles: public Hyperliquid mainnet candleSnapshot 15m rows stored with immutable identity
data_contract.required_continuity: explicitly measure missing 15m intervals; gaps reset completed-bar indicators

support_criteria: ZEC nominal and stress net PnL and profit factor exceed zero and one in the opened partition
ZEC nominal and stress net remain positive after the largest winner is removed
no-lookahead, append-invariance, gap reset, fixed-risk sizing, and timing tests pass
all seven assets are visible and excluded assets are absent on every TUI asset surface
unsupported asset-sides have no automatic entry authority
shared-account concurrency simulation passes before any live authority
falsifiers: ZEC development nominal or stress expectancy is non-positive
ZEC development depends on the largest winner
the requested mainnet history cannot support the frozen chronology
a future bar changes a prior entry, stop, size, or exit
any completed-4h decision is executed before its close
parameters are changed after viewing ZEC returns
